scope: Three family-level decisions after inspecting language-spaced examples and all stored evidence classes. The complete member lists are locked by digest. This is not individual annotation of each word.

decisions.reason: Transliterated -ija matches the Russian final sequence -ия across unrelated stems: аббревиация, абдукция, астропроекция, нация and оториноларингология do not share a whole-lemma root.

Spanish final -elo includes attached pronouns on unrelated verbs (abandónelo, recógelo, comiéndoselo) alongside unrelated nouns such as abuelo and riachuelo; the shared ending is not a lexical family.
Italian -ato marks past participles and adjectives on unrelated stems: abbandonato, generalato, aranciato and telomerizzato do not derive from one lexical root.

review_scope: Remove these incoherent surface groupings while retaining source lemmas and any other memberships. Some words share a grammatical suffix or clitic; this does not imply a shared whole-word etymology.
